confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors (beer, coffee, inexpensive and mid-range meals) rest on aggregated cost-of-living figures and menu excerpts seen in search results, mostly dated Feb-Jul 2026. Rand amounts were converted at an approximate rate implied by those sources, not a dedicated rand rate. Cocktail is weaker: it rests on one downtown venue reading and is set near twice the beer anchor as a local price-relationship check. Wine_glass is also weaker: it rests on a few scattered menu prices rather than an aggregate and is set against the beer anchor. Accommodation anchors are model estimates for Cape Town's July low season; no accommodation search was run and no live listings were checked. The FX observation comes from search excerpts of the RBA exchange-rates page, not a direct download of the F11.1 table, and the 19 Nov 2026 figure may not yet be posted.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable-city proxy was used; food and drink anchors are based on Cape Town-specific figures. Cocktail and wine_glass were cross-checked against the beer anchor, which served as the local price basis where direct knowledge was thin.
